BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.

2. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Windows.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.

5. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

7. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

9. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.

10. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.

11. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.

12. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Scaffolding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Roof Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Doors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

3. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.

6. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

7. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.

8. A — Information and Communication Technology

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.

11. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.

12. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Computer Aided Drawing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
